project.title: Infrastructure as Code, AWS Service Catalog, and CI/CD Automation

parentsummary.deliverables: Authored CloudFormation templates packaged as AWS Service Catalog products for on-demand Dev, Test, Prod, and Disaster Replay environments, alongside CI/CD pipeline integration and CloudWatch/EventBridge monitoring.
parentsummary.outcomes: Reduced on-demand environment provisioning for development, testing, production, and disaster replay from weeks to hours via AWS Service Catalog while supporting continuous Agile delivery.

challenge.summary: Continuous Agile development across the SMMS Replacement Project required frequent provisioning and realignment of development, testing, production, and disaster replay environments. Standing up multi-tier AWS environments took weeks before reusable Service Catalog templates were in place, slowing iteration across development, operations, and security teams.

deliverables: Authored reusable AWS CloudFormation Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates and packaged them as AWS Service Catalog products for on-demand development, testing, production, and disaster replay environments
Integrated end-to-end CI/CD delivery and release automation pipelines using Git, Jenkins, AWS CodeCommit, AWS CodeBuild, AWS CodeDeploy, and AWS CodePipeline
Managed container image repositories and service routing across continuous Agile development cycles using Amazon ECR and AWS Service Discovery
Built event-driven operational monitoring and automated event response using Amazon CloudWatch and Amazon EventBridge, supplemented by AWS Trusted Advisor
Standardized application configuration, credential storage, and remote host management with AWS Systems Manager, AWS Parameter Store, and AWS Secrets Manager
Reviewed and realigned codified infrastructure across continuous development cycles, coordinating technical changes between development and operations teams

outcomes: Reduced on-demand environment provisioning for development, testing, production, and disaster replay from weeks to hours using AWS Service Catalog products

Delivered reusable CloudFormation Infrastructure as Code templates, integrated CI/CD release pipelines, and CloudWatch/EventBridge event-driven monitoring to support continuous Agile development cycles
